sources.title: Enhancing Human Security through Local Climate Actions: Situational Assessment of Nalgad Municipality and Barekot Rural Municipality, Jajarkot District, Karnali Province, Nepal
sources.temporal_coverage: Municipal baseline assessment reported in the PDF; publication date is not stated on the report cover.
sources.methodology: Household baseline survey (824 households), consultations and assessment of municipal frameworks.
sources.limitations: Two municipalities only; not a national estimate or armed-conflict analysis.

sources.title: Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) 3.0
sources.temporal_coverage: NDC period to 2035; loss-and-damage discussion includes 2024 events.
sources.methodology: Government NDC submission with a national loss-and-damage account and cited event-attribution findings.
sources.limitations: The submission does not identify its event-attribution study here; impacts are not district-disaggregated.

sources.title: Nepal: 2024 Floods Response Plan, Humanitarian Needs and Priorities
sources.organization: United Nations Resident Coordinator and Nepal Humanitarian Country Team
sources.temporal_coverage: September 2024 floods and landslides; response plan for October–December 2024.
sources.methodology: Joint Humanitarian Country Team plan using NDRRMA reporting and initial rapid assessments.
sources.limitations: The plan says full damage estimates were still under government assessment; no independent evaluation.

sources.title: Nepal Floods and Landslides of September 2024: Updates 1 and 2
sources.temporal_coverage: UNDP operational updates dated 15 November 2024 and 5 January 2025 after the September floods and landslides.
sources.methodology: UNDP operational reporting on deployments and recovery activities.
sources.limitations: Self-reported outputs and ongoing activities; no independent outcome assessment.

claims.paraphrase: UNDP says climate-related floods, landslides and agricultural shifts threaten human security in Barekot and Nalgad, where over 90% rely on agriculture; gender inequalities heighten women's food, health and economic insecurity.
claims.limitations: Assessment findings from two municipalities; not an armed-conflict finding.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Report explicitly frames climate risks through human security and existing inequality.

claims.locator: Institutional frameworks, PDF pp. 34–35; early warning, PDF pp. 47–48.
claims.paraphrase: Both municipalities lacked formal EWS; Barekot also lacked weather and hydrological stations. Only 22% recognized an EWS and 1.7% knew access; plans faced funding or technical gaps.
claims.limitations: Survey and institutional findings are from the 2024 assessment.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: UNDP connects preparedness and warning access to human security.

claims.locator: PDF p. 31, 2024 extreme rainfall and glacier-lake outbursts.
claims.paraphrase: NDC 3.0 reports September 2024 floods and landslides killed 249 and displaced 11,000 families; cited models estimate climate change raised event intensity 10% and likelihood about 70%.

claims.locator: PDF p. 31, Thame GLOF account and glacial-lake risk.
claims.paraphrase: NDC records two August 2024 GLOFs that swept away Thame village; it separately reports glacier loss and rising GLOF risk, naming 47 potentially dangerous lakes in Nepal.
claims.limitations: The NDC does not attribute the specific Thame outburst to climate change.

claims.locator: PDF p. 3, situation overview; PDF p. 10, food-security impact.
claims.paraphrase: The plan reports 21 affected districts and 246 deaths; 46,569 ha of Madhesh farmland were damaged, with crop losses expected to worsen food insecurity and negative coping.
claims.limitations: As-of 7 October 2024 plan figures; damage assessment was still ongoing.

claims.locator: PDF p. 4, displacement-related needs; PDF p. 5, response objectives.
claims.paraphrase: Plan says displacement camps and service gaps heightened protection risks, especially for women, children, older people and people with disabilities; it prioritizes protection from violence and equal access.
claims.limitations: Response objectives are planned priorities, not evaluated outcomes.
claims.source_stated_fcv_link: Plan explicitly links flood displacement and service gaps with protection risks.

claims.locator: PDF p. 2, information-management and community deployments.
claims.paraphrase: UNDP reports district information officers and ten community volunteers in named Kavre, Rautahat and Panchthar localities supporting shelter-data collection and access to government assistance.
claims.limitations: Reported deployment outputs; no outcome evaluation.

claims.locator: PDF p. 2, Update 2, recovery activities reported 5 January 2025.
claims.paraphrase: As of 5 January 2025, conditional cash support for 260 households and debris clearance were ongoing; a 600-household cash-for-work activity remained planned.
claims.limitations: Status is the dated UNDP update; planned activity is not reported as delivered.

search_audit.query: Nepal official 2024 September flood landslide districts NDRRMA disaster report 2025 PDF
search_audit.outcome: Opened the HCT plan and UNDP municipal assessment; found named local climate vulnerability and dated flood impacts. The NDC records Thame GLOF impacts.

search_audit.query: Nepal climate flood landslide displacement conflict social tension local communities official UN report 2024 2025
search_audit.outcome: UNDP explicitly frames climate risks through human security and inequality; the HCT plan links post-flood displacement/service gaps to protection risks. No armed-conflict causal link is claimed.

search_audit.query: Nepal climate shocks affect FCV conflict protest violence displacement communities source report official 2024 2025
search_audit.outcome: Focused searches and opened reports did not establish that armed conflict drives climate vulnerability or that climate hazards caused armed violence; UNDP documents pre-existing social inequalities as vulnerability factors.

search_audit.query: Nepal local resilience capacity early warning disaster preparedness municipal 2024 2025 official report UN
search_audit.outcome: UNDP assesses municipal plans and early-warning capacity in two Jajarkot municipalities and reports dated local recovery deployments; reported activities are not independent impact evaluations.

gaps: The opened reports establish climate-related human-security, protection and livelihood pathways, but not a climate-to-armed-conflict causal link or conflict-driven adaptation constraint.
The UNDP local assessment covers two Jajarkot municipalities only; the 2024 flood-plan totals are preliminary, with limited district-level disaggregation.
The 7 October 2024 response plan and May 2025 NDC report different flood death and displacement totals/units; both are retained with their dates and sources, not reconciled.
UNDP recovery updates report deployment and ongoing/planned activities, not independent outcomes. The 2025 NDC does not identify the cited September 2024 event-attribution study.
